IgM autoantbodies with distinct specificities correlate with protection from certain clinical features of SLE.

IgM natural auto-antibodies (NAb) to apoptosis-associated antigens, including phosphorylcholine and malondialdehyde, correlate with protection from certain features of SLE.

the characterization of IgM NAbs in SLE and the identification of IgM NAAb subsets that may have protective functions in SLE.

the characterization of IgM NAbs and their role in the pathogenesis of SLE.
